question: Which of the following singer is honoured with the Padma Shri 2022 by the Government of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sonu Nigam.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sonu Nigam **has been honoured with the **Padma Shri 2022 **by the Government of India.
 
• Padma Shri is one of the **highest civilian award**s of India, which is conferred by the** President of India** in recognition of distinguished service in various fields such as** art, literature, science, social service, and public affairs.**
 
• Abhijeet Bhattacharya, Anu Malik, and Leslie Lewis are all popular Indian singers but have** not **been honoured with the Padma Shri 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Abhijeet Bhattacharya** is a **playback singer and music director** who has won several awards for his contribution to the Indian music industry, including** Filmfare Awards and National Film Awards.**
 
• **Anu Malik **is a **music director and singer** who has composed music for numerous Bollywood films and won several awards, including the** National Film Award and Filmfare Awards.**
 
• **Leslie Lewis **is a **singer, composer, and music producer **who is known for his fusion music and collaborations with various artists.
 
 
• He has won several awards for his contribution to Indian music, including the **MTV India and Channel V Awards.**
